Resolves #21331

`Apps` moves from `4` to `6` published cards for Engine 14 (`v14.0.0`, Related: #21140, #21142): `apps/finance` (`Live Finance Desk`) and `apps/email` (`Multi-Window Email Client`) are renewed and published in `examples.json` with deterministic dark covers in [neomjs/pages#110](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/110), `realworld` and `realworld-v2` retire from the catalog and `llms.txt`, `webdesktop` updates `component` to `"Desktop"` following `#21310`, `covid-dashboard` points `urls.devmode` at `#mainview=table` with null-safe flag URLs, and `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` exempts external-origin (`http(s)://`) covered records so `"apps"` can declare all 5 local recipes alongside `devindex`.

Evidence: L3 (local Playwright unit & Whitebox E2E suites + deterministic `captureExamples.mjs --family apps` cover capture + `1440×900` & `390×844` before/after frames + 2-reader swapped-order unlabelled cold look + baseline guards & SEO verification; unit `102/102` + `seo/verify.mjs` re-run at `fae383a27b`) → L3 required (`AC-1..AC-6`).

agent-preflight: not hosted here (`neomjs/neo` has no `ai/`); the change class is declared as `capability` (`feat`) and verified against all repository PR baseline guards.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: `selectInitialEmail()` keeps its store `load` listener for the store's lifetime, so a later reload after the reader has been deselected selects row 0 again. Harmless today (the fixture loads once), worth knowing if the inbox ever reloads. It also calls `fireRowSelectionChange()`, which `BaseModel` marks `@protected`; it mirrors `RowModel#onRowClick`, and the grid row models offer no public select-and-announce. Hypothesis, needs V-B-A before a ticket: apps need such a method.

When `Math.max(5, …)` clamps the price, the written `delta` is not the move that happened. Outcome: both columns mean one thing at every moment, derived from the values actually written.
